url.description:
URL and SignatureBinURL are public catalog download endpoints:
GET /v2/download/profile/ai/{version_id}/{type}[/{slug}], where version_id is
the version's profileVersionId.

details.description: Details holds optional structured context; empty object when omitted.

message.description: Message is a human-readable description of the error.

request_id.description: RequestID is the request ID echoed in logs and error responses.

expires_at.description:
ExpiresAt is when URL stops working, as RFC 3339 (UTC). It is the expiry the
signer actually used, so a client can tell a short-lived link from a long one,
warn before copying it, and re-resolve a queued download instead of trying a
dead URL.

download_url.description:
DownloadURL and SignatureBinURL are public catalog download endpoints:
GET /v2/download/profile/hub/{version_id}/{type}[/{slug}], where version_id
is the version uid (versions[].id).

description.example: Includes all pack artifacts for offline deployment

attributes.description: Attributes is transformed to retain only size and latestTag keys.

description.example: Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct model optimized for NVIDIA AI Enterprise.

labels.description: Labels is transformed from an array of key/value pairs into a map of string keys to string slice values.

download_url.description:
DownloadURL, SignatureBinURL, and HelmURL are public catalog download
endpoints: GET /v2/download/pack/{version_id}/{type}[/{slug}], where
version_id is the version metadata uid (versions[].id).

totalCount.description: TotalCount is the number of unique GPU builds in binaries (currently amd and nvidia).

id.description: ID is the unique installer version id (the appliance metadata.uid) for this GPU build.

entitledClasses.description:
EntitledClasses lists the artifact classes required to download gated or
private installers.

visibility.description: Visibility is the catalog visibility of the installer (public, gated, or private).

entitledClasses.description:
EntitledClasses lists the artifact classes required to download gated or
private installers.

id.description:
ID is the installer version id, used as versionid in
GET /v2/download/installer/{versionid}/{type}.

visibility.description: Visibility is the catalog visibility of the installer (public, gated, or private).

entitledClasses.description:
EntitledClasses lists the artifact classes required to download gated or
private installers. When the installer does not set them, they are based
on the product query parameter.

id.description:
ID is the unique installer version id (the appliance metadata.uid), used to
build public download endpoints GET /v2/download/installer/{version_id}/{type}.

visibility.description:
Visibility is the catalog visibility of the installer (public, gated, or
private). When the installer does not set it, it is based on the product
query parameter.

org_id.description: OrgID is the caller's active org at create time (optional when the user has none).

payload.description:
Payload is opaque editor-state JSON. Request bodies (and thus payload) are
capped at httperror.MaxJSONBodyBytes (1 MiB) by decodeAndValidateJSONBody.
Expected shape is documented by ProfileBundlePayload; kept as a map so
unknown UI fields round-trip until typed validation lands.

auth_session_id.description: AuthSessionID is a non-secret cookie-login marker for audit deduplication; never a credential.

capabilities.description:
Capabilities is the cap:* subset of Scope for client-side UX (e.g. showing admin routes).
Not an authorization decision; API routes still enforce scopes.

org_id.description: OrgID is the id of the user's active organization; empty when they have none.

orgs.description: Orgs lists every organization the user belongs to or has been invited to.

pending_invites.description: PendingInvites lists organizations the user has been invited to but has not accepted.

scope.description: Scope lists artifact-class (artifact:*) and capability (cap:*) grants for the current session.

current.description:
Current marks the organization currently selected as the caller's ambient org.
Named "current" (not "active") so clients do not conflate the selected org with
membership_status/org_status, which also use "active".

BearerAuth.description: An Artifact Studio API access key or a user session token, sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

info.description: The Artifact Studio API lets you browse the Spectro Cloud artifact catalog (packs, cluster profiles, PaletteAI profiles, and Palette installers), download artifacts your organization is entitled to, and manage profile bundles. Every /v2 response includes an X-API-Version header set to v2.
info.title: Artifact Studio API

get.description: Returns a short-lived signed download URL: a 302 redirect by default, or a JSON body {"url": "...", "expires_at": "..."} when the request sends Accept: application/json. Downloads one component of a Palette or Vertex installer version. versionid is the installer version id (versions[].id from GET /v2/installers/palette/versions) and identifies the product and variant on its own, so no other selectors are needed. type is the component name (for example zst). Use artifact to download the component (url, the default), its binary signature (signature_bin_url), or its signature file (signature_url). The component links in GET /v2/installers/palette/versions/{version}/binaries already point here. Requires a token. Gated and private installers also require your organization to be entitled to one of the installer's entitledClasses. Errors are returned as the v2 JSON error envelope when the request accepts application/json or application/problem+json, otherwise as an HTML page.

parameters.name: type

404.description: Installer binary or component URL missing (JSON error envelope or HTML page)

get.description: Returns NVIDIA AI Essentials resources from NVIDIA NGC, with optional search and resource type filters and fixed-size pages of up to 50 resources. Repeat resource_type or comma-separate its values to match any of them; q and resource_type must both match. metadata describes the whole catalog, while pagination.total counts the resources that match your filters. The catalog is refreshed from NGC periodically (every 5 minutes by default), so new NGC resources can take a few minutes to appear. Authentication is optional.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive literal search across name and display name
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Resource type filter (repeated or comma-separated for OR)
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.description: One-based page number; each page contains at most 50 resources
parameters.name: page

200.description: Filtered and paginated NVIDIA catalog payload

get.description: Returns Palette and Vertex installer versions, optionally filtered by product and limited to major releases, with page-based pagination. Each version includes its visibility (public, gated, or private) and entitledClasses: the artifact classes your organization needs to download a gated or private installer. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Product filter: palette, vertex, palette-ai, vertex-ai, vm-launchpad-appliance, or ai-launchpad-appliance
parameters.name: product

parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Invalid product, major_only, page, or limit parameter

get.description: Resolve a Palette installer minor alias (x.y) to the latest production patch version and return the matching installer spec payload. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

404.description: No production palette installer version exists for the requested minor

get.summary: Get the latest Palette installer version for a minor release

get.description: Returns the installer binaries for a Palette or Vertex version. Choose the product with product (palette when omitted). With product=vm-launchpad-appliance, fips and csi are required and select the exact appliance variant. With product=ai-launchpad-appliance, the response has one entry per GPU vendor; use gpu to return only amd or nvidia. Each component's url, signatureBinUrl, and signatureUrl link to GET /v2/download/installer/{version_id}/{type}[/{slug}] (signature links add ?artifact=signature_bin_url or ?artifact=signature_url). The response includes the installer's visibility (public, gated, or private) and entitledClasses: the artifact classes your organization needs to download a gated or private installer. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Palette version, or PaletteAI version for palette-ai and vertex-ai products
parameters.name: version

parameters.description: Installer product: palette (the default), vertex, palette-ai, vertex-ai, vm-launchpad-appliance, or ai-launchpad-appliance
parameters.name: product

parameters.description: Optional GPU filter for ai-launchpad-appliance (amd or nvidia); omit to return every GPU build
parameters.name: gpu

parameters.description: Required with product=vm-launchpad-appliance to select the FIPS variant
parameters.name: fips

parameters.description: Required with product=vm-launchpad-appliance to select the CSI variant
parameters.name: csi

200.description: AI Launchpad installer specs grouped by GPU

400.description: Invalid or conflicting parameters, or missing VM Launchpad fips/csi selectors

404.description: Palette installer binary not found

get.description: Returns the signed-in user's profile, active organization, the organizations they belong to or are invited to, and pending invitations (so invitees can see them without the email link). The active organization is the earliest-joined active membership. If you were invited before you had an account, or your sign-in identity changed, your account is matched by verified email. scope lists the access scopes on this request; capabilities is the cap:* subset of scope, for deciding which features to show in a client (API routes still enforce scopes). Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

401.description: Login required or missing JWT sub

404.description: User not found

get.description: Returns the pack catalog: one item per pack, with FIPS and non-FIPS builds combined, and each item's versions[] limited to the versions that match every version-level filter. Use this to browse packs; to work with individual builds (for example the FIPS, non-FIPS, and per-architecture builds of one pack), use GET /v2/packs/{name}/versions. fips, palette_version, cloud_type, and arch must all match on the same version. palette_version is an upper bound: a version matches when its Palette version is at or below the target. Targets can be full SemVer or major.minor, with an optional lowercase v; with several targets, the highest one applies. Versions with no Palette version always match, and versions with an invalid Palette version never do. An empty target imposes no limit, and an invalid target returns 400. Encode + in build metadata as %2B. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across pack name and display name, or an exact catalog id (the id field of an item)
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Version cloud type filter (comma-separated for OR)
parameters.name: cloud_type

parameters.description: SemVer ceilings: full SemVer or major.minor, optional lowercase v. Accepts comma-separated and repeated values; matches <= any target (the highest target). Empty tokens are ignored; no targets means unrestricted; any invalid target returns 400. Unspecified stored versions are included. Encode + as %2B.
parameters.name: palette_version

parameters.description: Cursor token for the next page
parameters.name: next

parameters.description: Cursor token for the previous page
parameters.name: prev

parameters.description: Maximum number of packs to return
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Invalid FIPS or palette version, or invalid cursor parameter

get.description: Returns the values available for each pack catalog filter (layer, cloud type, architecture, add-on type, Palette version), plus the total number of packs in the catalog (the same as pagination.total from GET /v2/packs/catalog). Use it to populate filter choices for GET /v2/packs/catalog. Authentication is optional.

Returns one pack catalog entry, with all of its versions, by catalog id or by pack name (without any FIPS suffix). Use this to show one pack as the catalog groups it; use GET /v2/packs/{name} for paginated, per-build version data. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Catalog id (the id field from GET /v2/packs/catalog, e.g. 843807822635512686) or pack name (e.g. edge-k8s)
parameters.name: catalogid

404.description: No catalog pack exists for the requested catalogid

get.description: Returns one version of a catalog pack by catalog id (or pack name) and version (an exact version number such as 1.29.13, or a version id). Includes download_url, signature_bin_url, and helm_url (links to the GET /v2/download/pack endpoints), sha256, size_bytes, release_date, arch, visibility, and entitledClasses. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Catalog id (the id field from GET /v2/packs/catalog, e.g. 843807822635512686) or pack name (e.g. edge-k8s)
parameters.name: catalogid

parameters.description: Exact pack version (e.g. 1.29.13) or version id (versions[].id)
parameters.name: versionid

400.description: Invalid catalogid, versionid, or query parameter

404.description: No catalog pack version exists for the requested catalogid and versionid

get.description: Retrieve a single pack by name (spec.pack.name) with its pack-level metadata (display name, layer, cloud types, architectures) and the list of all available versions. Pack-level metadata reflects the latest version. Use this, with GET /v2/packs/{name}/versions, when you work with individual builds; to show one pack with its FIPS and non-FIPS builds grouped, use GET /v2/packs/catalog/{catalogid}. Optional filters narrow the versions: repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Cursor token for the next page (version metadata UID)
parameters.name: next

parameters.description: Cursor token for the previous page (version metadata UID)
parameters.name: prev

parameters.description: Maximum number of versions to return
parameters.name: limit

404.description: No pack exists for the requested name

get.description: Retrieve all available versions of a single pack by name (spec.pack.name), each with full download coordinates (download_url, sha256, size_bytes), release date, architectures, and cloud types. Versions are returned newest-first and pack-level metadata reflects the latest version. Optional filters narrow the versions: repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Cursor token for the next page (version metadata UID)
parameters.name: next

parameters.description: Cursor token for the previous page (version metadata UID)
parameters.name: prev

parameters.description: Maximum number of versions to return
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Pack versions with download details and cursor pagination

404.description: No pack exists for the requested name

get.description: Returns the latest version of a pack within a minor version (x.y), for example the newest 1.29.z of edge-k8s. Optional filters narrow which versions are considered. Repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive search across pack name, display name, and version, or an exact pack id (the id field of an item)
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Pack layer filter (comma-separated for OR, e.g. layer=cni,csi)
parameters.name: layer

404.description: No pack version exists for the requested name and minor

get.summary: Get the latest pack version for a minor release

get.description: Retrieve a single pack version by name (spec.pack.name) and exact version (spec.pack.version), including the downloadable artifact URL, SHA256 checksum, and size. Optional filters narrow the versions: repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

200.description: Pack version with download URL, SHA256, and size

404.description: No pack version exists for the requested name and version

get.summary: Get a pack version by version number

get.description: Returns one pack version by pack name and version id (versions[].id from GET /v2/packs/{name}/versions or from the pack catalog), including the download URL, SHA-256 checksum, and size. A pack's catalog id does not identify a version. Optional filters narrow the versions: repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.

200.description: Pack version with download URL, SHA256, and size

404.description: No pack exists for the requested name and id

get.summary: Get a pack version by ID

get.description: Returns your profile bundles, newest first, with cursor pagination (next, prev, and limit from 1 to 50, default 25). Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

post.description: Creates a draft profile bundle owned by you, with a name, pack_count, pack_size, and a JSON payload. The request body can be at most 1 MiB. Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

delete.description: Deletes one of your profile bundles by id. Deleting a bundle that is already gone also returns 200 with the id. Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

parameters.description: Profile bundle id (the id field returned when the bundle is created or listed)
parameters.name: id

404.description: Not found

get.description: Returns one of your profile bundles by id. Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

parameters.description: Profile bundle id (the id field returned when the bundle is created or listed)
parameters.name: id

404.description: Not found

patch.description: Updates one of your profile bundles. Fields you omit are unchanged; sending payload replaces the whole stored payload (send {} to clear it). Returns 409 if another request changes the bundle at the same time; fetch it and retry. Requires a token; an API access key acts as the user who owns it (for an organization key, the user who created it).

parameters.description: Profile bundle id (the id field returned when the bundle is created or listed)
parameters.name: id

get.description: Returns the Cluster Profiles catalog: public PaletteAI and Profiles Hub profiles in one cursor-paginated list. Use this to browse both sources together; to browse one source with its source-specific filters and fields, use GET /v2/profiles/ai/catalog or GET /v2/profiles/hub/catalog. Each item includes source, sourceId, a composite id (palette-ai:{sourceId} or profiles-hub:{sourceId}), visibility, and entitledClasses. Profiles Hub items include versions[], with their packs grouped by component and download_url / signature_bin_url links to the GET /v2/download/profile/hub endpoints. PaletteAI items include a short variants[] list, tags from all published versions, and resource requirements from the latest version of the primary variant. Use GET /v2/profiles/catalog/{catalogid} for full details. Repeat a filter or comma-separate its values to match any of them; different filters must all match. Authentication is optional. Downloading any item requires a token, and gated items also require your organization to be entitled to them.
